root_cause.text: In the UFS subsystem, `__ufshcd_wl_suspend()` cancels the delayed work `hba->ufs_rtc_update_work` too late, allowing `ufshcd_rtc_work()` to execute and access hardware registers after `ufshcd_vops_suspend()` has already gated the clocks.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff moves `cancel_delayed_work_sync(&hba->ufs_rtc_update_work)` from the end of `__ufshcd_wl_suspend()` to before the call to `ufshcd_vops_suspend(hba, pm_op, PRE_CHANGE)`, which, as described in the commit message, prevents `ufshcd_rtc_work()` from running concurrently with clock gating operations and triggering an SError.

bic_trace_step.reason: This commit introduces the UFS RTC support and adds the vulnerable code. Specifically, in `__ufshcd_wl_suspend()`, `cancel_delayed_work_sync(&hba->ufs_rtc_update_work)` is placed after `ufshcd_vops_suspend(hba, pm_op, POST_CHANGE)` (lines 9824-9828). This allows `ufshcd_rtc_work()` to run and access hardware registers after the clocks have already been gated by `ufshcd_vops_suspend()`, which is the exact root cause of the vulnerability.
